notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
I have pushed a small update to fix various issues caused by the rematch feature.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would on occasion not reset the score for both the Host and the Client
[*] After a rematch, scoring a goal on the losing players' goal will no longer cause a second ball to spawn
[/list]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Remember If you are looking for people to play with, or need help port forwarding, try the new Discord!
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791466287006/announcements/detail/1722001656483616081
